messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] cmdstan with MKL on Windows 10
parts:
Sounds like an issue with MKL config. We don't do anything
that generates 16-bit applications---I didn't even know
there was such a thing.

MKL isn't going to help with Stan because we use Eigen for
all of our linear algebra and Boost for all of our math
computing.

- Bob
